An offline transcript replay revises stored notes; the later session retrieves the revised context.

Two session islands with distinct frames, an overhead curved replay bay and a persistent note shelf below it. Depict unmarked transcript reels with solid broad segments, an open comparison cradle with original and corrected note tiles in distinct silhouettes, a small collection of organized note tiles, and a fresh context tray with a matching tile. No arrow links model parameters, access controls or permissions. Leave the lower limitation detached.

Use at least twelve meaningful forms with a distinct internal hierarchy. Print only these exact phrases, exactly once each: "Session transcripts", "Offline replay", "Compare source", "Revised notes", "Later session", "Internal evaluation". Bold sans serif. Priority typography at least 36px, other labels at least 28px on the 1200×630 export. Keep all labels inside 40px safe margins, outside connectors, and inside the reserved boxes. Do not print instructions, region IDs, positions or metadata.

Only these arrows, with arrowheads attached to actual object ports rather than label text: Session transcripts → Offline replay. Only when prior transcripts are selected for offline replay. No route from transcript to later session across the gap. Offline replay → Revised notes. When transcript comparison supports a correction. No arrow to training or permissions. Revised notes → Later session. When revised context is retrieved in a later session. No link to the benchmark limitation.

No people, humanoids, avatars, shields, gears, knobs, dashboards, logos, invented interfaces or controls, realistic photos, scenery, fake writing, decorative microstrokes, charts, unsupported numbers, success badges, permission changes or alternate implied flows.
